owner_instruction_excerpt: Yes — approving the hybrid proposed in answer to 'Is there a hybrid option': calibrate the prior from DIAL's own outcomes, use the posterior smoothing weight as the confidence dial rather than a hard threshold, add a sample-count tie-break, and delete the unread below_threshold_behaviour field.

decision.question: A pair with a measured record below the cold-start prior ranked below a pair with no record at all. Correct Bayesian behaviour only if the prior is calibrated, and it was an inherited constant.
decision.resolution: Calibrate the prior from DIAL's own rating-bearing outcomes; use the posterior smoothing weight as a continuous confidence dial instead of a hard threshold; break exact ties toward the better-evidenced pair; delete the unread below_threshold_behaviour field.
rejected_alternatives: Lowering the prior to a pessimistic constant, which is the same unprincipled guess pointing the other way and penalises the untried.
UCB or Thompson sampling, which is the textbook answer to explore/exploit but brings tuning constants and machinery that a fleet of this size will not repay.

notes: The prior is now computed: per-archetype once an archetype has 30 of its own rating-bearing samples, global once 30 pooled exist, seeded at 0.75 until then. Only rating-bearing samples calibrate, so resource-caused failures cannot drag the population mean down either.

prior_weight raised from 8 to 12. This is the confidence dial: a pair's own record carries samples/(weight+samples) of its score, blending continuously so nothing jumps in the ordering as a pair crosses a sample count. Chosen because DIAL's jobs are substantial and infrequent, so over-reacting to a few bad runs costs more than reacting slowly. It remains a judgment and should be revisited from real data.

below_threshold_behaviour is deleted. It declared a RANK_ON_DECLARED_CAPABILITY_AND_COST mode that no routing code read. An earlier statement that policy and code were 'different systems' was too strong: the code satisfied it structurally, because an unmeasured pair's quality is a constant across all unmeasured pairs, so ordering among them already fell to fit and cost. It was dead config rather than a contradiction, and dead config that looks load-bearing is worse than none.

min_samples_for_evidenced_placement is retained for reporting only: it drives the below_reference flag in the trace so a reader can see where DIAL does not really know yet. It gates visibility, never ranking or eligibility.

A probe caught a real bug during implementation: measured and unmeasured pairs were being scored on DIFFERENT scales -- an unmeasured pair returned the bare prior while a measured one returned a weighted blend including a defect term, so a below-average pair scored ABOVE an unknown. Both branches now use the identical blend. AR-26 asserts the comparison in both directions and was verified to go RED when the unification is reverted.

AR-12 was rewritten to assert behaviour rather than read config. Its previous form asserted the value of below_threshold_behaviour -- the field that turned out to be unread -- so it was passing for the same class of reason AR-06 originally did.
